name: Mautic Audiences: Audience field
description: A field type that says which Mautic segments or tags an entity is for: an editorial targeting hint for templates and Views, and, per field, an opt-in view access gate.

suggests.drupal/search_api: Lets this submodule filter search results by audience at query time via the Mautic audience access processor, so gated content stays in one index.

project_description:
Back to top 

 What it does 
 Mautic Audiences turns the segments and tags a visitor has in Mautic into a first-class Drupal primitive: a single resolver service that every audience-aware feature on the site can consult, without anyone re-implementing the wiring.

 The resolver reads from local stores ( user.data for authenticated users, keyvalue.expirable for anonymous visitors keyed by the mtc_id cookie). The Mautic API is only touched on webhook receipt, cron reconciliation, or a manual Drush sync, never on the render path. Two visitors in the same audience share the same cache entries because cache contexts key on the resolved audience, not on the cookie.

 This sub-module, Audience field, adds a mautic_audience field type that records which Mautic segments or tags a piece of content is for. Left as a targeting hint it drives templates and Views; turned on per field it becomes a view access gate for that field's entities, with a Views row filter and a Search API processor to keep listings and search in step.
